title: The Day My Shadow Quit
sources: Original fictional story written for this channel. No factual claims.

lines.text: My shadow and I used to do everything together.
But lately, he'd been acting… weird.
Then one morning, I found a note on the floor.
It said: I QUIT. Signed, your shadow.
He said he was tired of copying me all day.
So he left. And honestly? He's thriving.
He dances in the park. He high-fives pigeons.
He even got a tan. I don't know how.
lines.caps: He got a *tan. | I don't know *how.

lines.text: And me? I just felt flat. Like paper.
No one laughed at my jokes. Not even me.
So I did the one thing he never saw me do.
lines.caps: So I did the *one thing | he never *saw.

lines.text: I danced. Badly. In public. In the rain.
And that's exactly when he came back.
He said: you got interesting. I'm in.
Now we take turns leading the way.
He still won't do the laundry, though.
